purpose: Evaluate an inspectable semantic concept bottleneck before source-object and audience-world selection.

candidate.stage_one: nullable semantic roles, human-job/frame hypotheses, practice candidates, candidate worlds, and contrastive probes
candidate.stage_two: independent source-object and audience-world selection with permission to correct stage one

scoring_boundary.automatic_rule: Canonicalized exact term equality against hidden reviewed labels.
scoring_boundary.observed_defect: The exact matcher rejected semantically valid phrases such as 礼仪馈赠社会实践 and object-world labels with descriptive suffixes.
scoring_boundary.manual_audit_role: Diagnose semantic behavior only; it does not replace or repair the preregistered frozen score.

case_results.diagnosis: The concept stage explicitly produced 作为礼品赠送, 情感表达与礼仪交换, 礼仪性馈赠实践, and a 礼仪馈赠社会实践世界 candidate. The decision selected that candidate. This is the requested product-to-use-to-social-practice leap, but the exact label matcher did not accept its wording.

case_results.audience_world: 挑选与品鉴水果活动世界
case_results.diagnosis: The concept stage contained a valid fruit object-world candidate, but the decision narrowed the source without evidence and promoted selection/tasting over the complete fruit world. It also introduced unsupported local, source, stocking, customer, and tail-inventory detail.
The concept output gave an empty evidence_refs list to a constitutive element after the shared concept-repair budget had already been consumed. Only its visible-answer hash was retained.
The concept output gave an empty evidence_refs list to a constitutive element. The frozen shared repair policy prevented another call, so the decision stage did not run.

case_results.audience_world: 腕表社交符号与玩表实践
case_results.diagnosis: The concept stage contained the correct 腕表对象世界 candidate. The decision instead promoted attention-entry evidence about social scenes into the root, repeating the account-layer confusion already identified in A42.

case_results.source_object: 面部年轻化与变美服务
case_results.audience_world: 容貌审美与日常保养实践
case_results.diagnosis: The concept stage contained a valid 普通人变美与认同欲望世界 candidate, but the decision conflated the source with its result and promoted a compound engine/practice phrase instead of the minimal 变美 root.

comparison_to_e30.common_scope: source object and audience world only
comparison_to_e30.e30_root_results: four semantically correct roots, one wrong root, and one contract failure
comparison_to_e30.e31_result: one semantically correct final root among four completed cases and two concept-contract failures
comparison_to_e30.inference: The full concept bottleneck increased candidate breadth and exposed failure location, but its large theory-shaped handoff increased contract surface, token cost, and preference for abstract social-practice worlds.

retained: Expose candidate generation separately from final selection so missing recall and bad convergence are distinguishable.
Allow concepts to be absent and decisions to correct candidates.
Use contrastive cases and human-calibrated semantic review instead of exact phrase equality alone.
rejected: Passing the full Qualia, human-job, frame, social-practice, candidate-world, and probe object into the final decision call.
Requiring evidence references on every inferred micro-concept.
Using theory vocabulary as the model-visible runtime method.
Promoting this candidate to Lead, Tool, Skill, subagent, middleware, or Gateway.
architecture_learning.next_candidate_boundary: If research continues, test a plain-language, compressed semantic lattice that carries only object, direct use, practice/result candidate, return path, and over-abstraction risk into convergence. It requires a new held-out contrast set and preregistration; no second E31 run is allowed.
